```{r}
  "tidyr",

  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {

    paste(

      collapse = ", "
    )
```

```{r}
check_file <- function(
    file,
    description
) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      description,
      " not found:\n",
      file
    )
  }
}


clean_pathway_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_remove(
      "^HALLMARK_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "_",
      " "
    )
}


contrast_label_lookup <- c(
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" =
    "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-L",

  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H" =
    "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-H",

  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" =
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
)
```

```{r}
read_gsva_stability <- function(
    file,
    dataset
) {
  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset,
      " GSVA bootstrap-stability file"
    )
  )

  x <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "pathway",
    "primary_logFC",
    "primary_FDR",
    "tested_rate",
    "bootstrap_sign_consistency"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(x)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      " GSVA stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (!params$effect_column %in% names(x)) {
    stop(
      "Requested effect column '",
      params$effect_column,
      "' is not present in ",
      file
    )
  }

  x %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Dataset =
        dataset,

      primary_logFC =
        as.numeric(
          primary_logFC
        ),

      primary_FDR =
        as.numeric(
          primary_FDR
        ),

      tested_rate =
        as.numeric(
          tested_rate
        ),

      bootstrap_sign_consistency =
        as.numeric(
          bootstrap_sign_consistency
        ),

      effect =
        as.numeric(
          .data[[
            params$effect_column
          ]]
        )
    )
}


crc_raw <- read_gsva_stability(
  params$crc_stability_file,
  "CRC"
)


ucec_raw <- read_gsva_stability(
  params$ucec_stability_file,
  "UCEC"
)
```

```{r}
apply_stability_definition <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      primary_significant_relaxed =
        !is.na(
          primary_FDR
        ) &
        primary_FDR <=
        params$primary_fdr_cutoff,

      tested_rate_pass =
        !is.na(
          tested_rate
        ) &
        tested_rate >=
        params$tested_rate_cutoff,

      sign_consistency_pass =
        !is.na(
          bootstrap_sign_consistency
        ) &
        bootstrap_sign_consistency >=
        params$bootstrap_sign_consistency_cutoff,

      bootstrap_stable_relaxed =
        tested_rate_pass &
        sign_consistency_pass,

      stable_relaxed =
        primary_significant_relaxed &
        bootstrap_stable_relaxed
    )
}


crc <- apply_stability_definition(
  crc_raw
)


ucec <- apply_stability_definition(
  ucec_raw
)
```

```{r}
stability_counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  crc,
  ucec
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Contrast %in%
      params$contrasts
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Dataset,
    Contrast
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pathways =
      dplyr::n(),

    primary_FDR_significant =
      sum(
        primary_significant_relaxed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    bootstrap_direction_stable =
      sum(
        bootstrap_stable_relaxed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    primary_and_bootstrap_stable =
      sum(
        stable_relaxed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Contrast_label =
      unname(
        contrast_label_lookup[
          Contrast
        ]
      )
  )
```

```{r}
prepare_three_contrast_plot <- function(
    x
) {
  three <- x %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast %in%
        params$contrasts
    )

  selected_pathways <- three %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      pathway
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      stable_in_any_contrast =
        any(
          stable_relaxed,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      stable_in_any_contrast
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      pathway
    )

  plot_df <- three %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      pathway %in%
        selected_pathways
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Contrast_label =
        unname(
          contrast_label_lookup[
            Contrast
          ]
        ),

      Contrast_label =
        factor(
          Contrast_label,
          levels = c(
            "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
            "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-H",
            "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
          )
        ),

      Stability =
        ifelse(
          stable_relaxed,
          "Stable",
          "Not stable"
        ),

      Stability =
        factor(
          Stability,
          levels = c(
            "Stable",
            "Not stable"
          )
        ),

      significance_label =
        ifelse(
          primary_significant_relaxed,
          "*",
          ""
        )
    )

  
  
  
  
  
  
  pathway_order <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      pathway
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      ordering_effect =
        if (
          any(
            Contrast ==
              "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
          )
        ) {
          effect[
            which(
              Contrast ==
                "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
            )[1]
          ]
        } else {
          effect[
            which.max(
              abs(
                effect
              )
            )
          ]
        },

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(
        ordering_effect
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      pathway
    )

  plot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pathway =
        clean_pathway_name(
          pathway
        ),

      Pathway =
        factor(
          Pathway,
          levels =
            rev(
              clean_pathway_name(
                pathway_order
              )
            )
        )
    )
}


crc_plot_df <- prepare_three_contrast_plot(
  crc
)


ucec_plot_df <- prepare_three_contrast_plot(
  ucec
)
```

```{r}
plot_three_contrast_gsva <- function(
    df,
    dataset,
    output_stub,
    title =
      "Hallmark pathway expression across MSI/TMB subtypes"
) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning(
      dataset,
      ": no pathways were stable in any of the three contrasts."
    )

    return(
      NULL
    )
  }

  
  effect_range <- range(
    df$effect,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  star_offset <- max(
    diff(
      effect_range
    ) * 0.025,
    0.002
  )

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      star_x =
        effect +
        ifelse(
          effect >= 0,
          star_offset,
          -star_offset
        ),

      star_hjust =
        ifelse(
          effect >= 0,
          0,
          1
        )
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x =
        effect,

      y =
        Pathway,

      fill =
        Contrast_label,

      alpha =
        Stability
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width =
            0.78,
          preserve =
            "single"
        ),

      width =
        0.68,

      color =
        "grey25",

      linewidth =
        0.18
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data =
        df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          primary_significant_relaxed
        ),

      ggplot2::aes(
        x =
          star_x,

        label =
          significance_label,

        group =
          Contrast_label
      ),

      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width =
            0.78
        ),

      hjust =
        df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          primary_significant_relaxed
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          star_hjust
        ),

      vjust =
        0.40,

      size =
        4.2,

      fontface =
        "bold",

      inherit.aes =
        TRUE,

      show.legend =
        FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept =
        0,

      linewidth =
        0.50,

      color =
        "grey45"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values =
        params$contrast_colors,

      breaks = c(
        "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
        "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-H",
        "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
      ),

      drop =
        FALSE,

      name =
        "Contrast"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_alpha_manual(
      values =
        c(
          "Stable" =
            params$stable_alpha,

          "Not stable" =
            params$unstable_alpha
        ),

      breaks = c(
        "Stable",
        "Not stable"
      ),

      drop =
        FALSE,

      name =
        "Bootstrap stability"
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        title,

      subtitle =
        paste0(
          dataset,
          ": pathways stable in at least one pairwise contrast"
        ),

      x =
        "Pathway logFC",

      y =
        "Pathway",

      caption =
        paste0(
          "* primary FDR \u2264 ",
          params$primary_fdr_cutoff,
          "; stable = FDR \u2264 ",
          params$primary_fdr_cutoff,
          ", tested rate \u2265 ",
          params$tested_rate_cutoff,
          ", sign consistency \u2265 ",
          params$bootstrap_sign_consistency_cutoff
        )
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_minimal(
      base_size =
        11
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          hjust =
            0.5,
          size =
            12
        ),

      plot.subtitle =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          hjust =
            0.5,
          size =
            9,
          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      axis.title.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            13
        ),

      axis.title.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            16
        ),

      axis.text.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            8.5,
          color =
            "grey25"
        ),

      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            9,
          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      panel.grid.major.y =
        ggplot2::element_line(
          color =
            "grey90",
          linewidth =
            0.35
        ),

      panel.grid.major.x =
        ggplot2::element_line(
          color =
            "grey92",
          linewidth =
            0.35
        ),

      panel.grid.minor =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      legend.box =
        "vertical",

      plot.caption =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            8,
          hjust =
            0,
          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      plot.margin =
        ggplot2::margin(
          8,
          12,
          8,
          8
        )
    )

  n_pathways <- dplyr::n_distinct(
    df$Pathway
  )

  plot_height <- max(
    6,
    0.33 *
      n_pathways +
      2.4
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".svg"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      10,

    height =
      plot_height,

    device =
      "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".pdf"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      10,

    height =
      plot_height,

    device =
      grDevices::cairo_pdf
  )

  p
}
```

```{r}
make_key_pathway_df <- function(
    x
) {
  x %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast %in%
        params$contrasts,

      pathway %in%
        params$key_pathways
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Contrast_label =
        unname(
          contrast_label_lookup[
            Contrast
          ]
        ),

      Contrast_label =
        factor(
          Contrast_label,
          levels = c(
            "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-L",
            "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-H",
            "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
          )
        ),

      Stability =
        ifelse(
          stable_relaxed,
          "Stable",
          "Not stable"
        ),

      Stability =
        factor(
          Stability,
          levels = c(
            "Stable",
            "Not stable"
          )
        ),

      significance_label =
        ifelse(
          primary_significant_relaxed,
          "*",
          ""
        ),

      Pathway =
        clean_pathway_name(
          pathway
        ),

      Pathway =
        factor(
          Pathway,
          levels =
            rev(
              clean_pathway_name(
                params$key_pathways
              )
            )
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
make_pattern_summary <- function(
    x
) {
  x %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast %in%
        params$contrasts
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Contrast_short =
        dplyr::case_when(
          Contrast ==
            "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" ~
            "MSIH_vs_MSSL",

          Contrast ==
            "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H" ~
            "MSIH_vs_MSSH",

          Contrast ==
            "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" ~
            "MSSH_vs_MSSL"
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Dataset,
      pathway,
      Contrast_short,
      stable_relaxed,
      primary_logFC,
      primary_FDR
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from =
        Contrast_short,

      values_from =
        c(
          stable_relaxed,
          primary_logFC,
          primary_FDR
        )
    )
}


pattern_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_pattern_summary(
    crc
  ),
  make_pattern_summary(
    ucec
  )
)


write.csv(
  pattern_summary,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "GSVA_three_contrast_pathway_pattern_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
